head-spin.prompt: FRAME FORMAT:256x256 RGBA, identical canvas in every frame, fixed physical skull center128,128, transparent20px safety margin, one constant proportional scale. Exactly ONE complete clockwise360-degree roll around the axis perpendicular to the screen, returning to the original upright pose. The skull always faces the camera; this is a wheel-like roll, NOT a yaw turn, not looking away or showing the back. Start upright, then roll smoothly through right-sideways90, upside-down180, left-sideways270, fully upright360. Mechanical bronze skull and two eye emitters remain rigidly connected around the same center. Eyes burn yellow-orange throughout. Preserve the exact forehead lens, two horns, eye sockets, bronze armor panels, vertical grill teeth and crisp Neo Geo pixel clusters. Subtle changing metallic light gives physical depth. NO face morphing, breathing size, zoom, translating, body, lasers or background. Fixed camera. End at the same exact upright pose for continuous rotation.

Build smoothly to full laser-ready brightness by the last frame.
